utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in and it should really help out around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is it really coming together, or is that just talk? I’d like to hear a little more confirmation before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it’s real — I heard there’s already a solid list of volunteers and a few repairs lined up. I can ask around for the latest details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and tell folks what’s needed. If you’ve got any updates for me, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I don’t have any updates right now, but I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll keep checking in and share anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — if you can bring some screwdrivers, duct tape, and a power strip, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring screwdrivers, duct tape, and a power strip.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tools and spare parts right now—if you can bring anything usable, I’ll sort it. I can also tell you what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check my shed for spare screws, tape, and a wrench. Tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up a time around the school run—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s brilliant, Faye — I just need a couple of helpers and someone to keep a simple list of the bits we’re collecting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do that — I’ll ask a couple of parents and keep a simple list of what comes in. What day do you want me to aim for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like to know the plan ahead of time—what’s the repair drive schedule, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact schedule right this second, but I’ll check and get it to you soon. If you can help with loading the donated parts or tools, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—just let me know the time as soon as you have it. I can help with loading the parts and tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. If you want, I can invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thank you. Just please make sure they know the time and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let them know it starts at 4 PM and to drop things off by the community shed. I’ll spread the word right away!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—do you know what they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we still need a few more volunteers for setup, and someone to help track donated tools and supplies. If you’re free, I’d love to put you down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with that — please put me down for setup, and I’ll keep track of the tools and supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m following along—what details do you want me to check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you check what tools we still need, and whether anyone’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check that—do you want me to look at the current tool list and sign-up sheet, or should I ask around first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I can jump in late and keep it simple too. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Could you start by sorting the donations, and I’ll handle the sign-in list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools do you have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer, a screwdriver set, and a cordless drill ready to lend. If you need anything else, just ask.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair drive details yet, but I can keep track if you tell me the location.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll grab the location and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send me the location when you have it, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’d appreciate that — I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I’d like that confirmed too—what time and where are we dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s confirm the exact time and the drop-off address before we head out, so nobody’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help — could you share the flyer with neighbors and ask around for anyone who can volunteer tools or repair skills?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll share the flyer with the neighbors and ask around for anyone who can lend tools or repair skills.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick inventory list for the repair drive—what supplies do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late as usual, but I can grab tape, gloves, and a few basic tools. Just tell me what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That covers the basics, thanks—could you also bring a flashlight and a couple extension cords if you can? I’ll handle the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can keep an eye out for any updates and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Tess—thank you. I’m juggling school pickup right now, so any updates on the repair drive would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Faye—I’ll keep you posted if anything changes. Hope school pickup goes smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but I’m not sure what needs fixing yet. What’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly small stuff: loose steps, leaky faucets, and a few broken screens. I’m making a quick list now, so if you spot anything, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and send you anything I notice.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you help collect the repair items and bring them by the community center this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that this afternoon. Just let me know which items to collect and what time to bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll put the word out right away—everyone should know about the repair drive. Want me to invite folks on our street first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please start with our street first. I’d really appreciate the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with our street and let everyone know today. I’ll keep you posted on who I reach.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive drop-off spot—where should I note it for today?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s note it at the community shed by the front walk today. I’ll stop by after lunch and check it with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll mark the community shed by the front walk for today. I’ll be there after lunch to check it with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get the sign-up list sorted yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed it yet — let me check the sign-up list first before I say it’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know once you’ve checked it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Oren — I’m heading out now, and I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and who’s handling the drop-off first. That’ll make it easier to plan around the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check the timing and who’s coordinating the drop-off, then I’ll let you know. That should make planning easier.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — once you’ve got that, could you send me the time and the contact name? I’ll plan my schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m keeping an ear out. If I spot anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. If you hear anything, just send it my way and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet — what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking in with folks and lining up the next few fixes now — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the latest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass the word along and keep repeating the plan to folks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll swing by late and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep telling folks the plan and make sure everyone knows you’ll be by late.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s needed for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’m pretty sure we still need basic repair supplies and a few volunteers, but I’d double-check the flyer just in case. If you want, I can grab the exact list later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll double-check the flyer first, then we can see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Kira—just tell me what you can take on, and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm what’s still left on the list? I don’t want to promise the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I still need one person for the lamp fix, someone to sort the tool table, and a couple of runners for pickup and drop-off. Tell me what fits you, and I’ll put your name next to it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the plan and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — we’re sorting the repair drive schedule now, and I’ll send you the plan as soon as it’s set. We’ll probably need help later this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—just let me know the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around the school schedule. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — could you do late afternoon after school lets out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon should work for me after pickup. Just send me the exact time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to help, just been a bit scatterbrained; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: If you can, bring the toolbox from my porch and a roll of duct tape. I’ve got the rest noted down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — toolbox from your porch and a roll of duct tape. I’ll head over now and bring them back to you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—did they get enough folks signed up?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure—I missed the last update. I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great. I’ll ask around too and see if anyone’s heard back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. Just let me know what we’re still short on, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Cleo — I’ll check what we’re short on and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll be ready when you do. We’ll get it sorted out together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can spare.
